name: Waterborne:Immersion
source:
Alex finds themselves standing in an 18th century styled grand salon, enraptured by the lavish decoration and atmosphere. Which would be a wondrous and welcome situation if not for the fact they have no memory of how they came to be there. As Alex begins to question everything, they discover that  the answers  are more and more sinister.

[From [url=https://lazytigermade.itch.io/waterborne2]Itch.io[/url]]
